main_text.p: dus, donec ad summum Pon-tificem qui præsit toti Eccle-siæ deveniamus.

Alterum est quo submonere lectorem meum debeo, illud est; quod cum Scripta Clarissimi viri Petri Molinæi Canonici Cantuariensis, tum mea, soleant ire in vulgus, ut unius authoris partus; atque inde quæ in uno, aut displicent, aut probantur, alteri imputentur; Ut nolim quicquam detrahi Illi, quem Parentis loco habeo, observo & colo, propter ejus ingentia in me merita, ita velim ab eo distingui, qui me longis spatiis ætatis, longioribus ingenii & eruditionis

page.notes: Running head reads "Admonitio." Page-level text is set in italic for the passages marked; the word "illud est" and the letters "s" are rendered as printed (long s as s). Some words are blurred in the scan, e.g. "Alterum dz", which I read as "Alterum d<ex>" and have transcribed as "Alterum est" only tentatively; the initial "Ut" is printed with a large decorative initial. The last line "ditionis" is set flush right.
